headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-6 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Griffin Conine leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0, with Eduardo Rodriguez pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Washington Nationals 5-2, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jakob Junis of the Texas Rangers, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The Rangers also transferred Jose Corniell from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list, and Danny Jansen from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Curtis Mead of the Boston Red Sox has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left wrist tracture.

The Los Angeles Angels traded Logan O'Hoppe and Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for SS Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles traded RF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The San Diego Padres signed SS Nu'u Contrades.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, ultimately taking the game 8-6. Griffin Conine led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eduardo Rodriguez pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Gabriel Moreno led the Diamondbacks' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Nationals 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Trey Yesavage earned the win with 6.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Tigers in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a hard-fought 10-9 win over the Detroit Tigers, overcoming a late deficit to secure the victory. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers in a closely contested matchup. Impact hitters for the Rays included Yandy Díaz and Cedric Mullins, while Jonny DeLuca also made a notable contribution.

top_news.title: **Rangers Roster Hit by Injury**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-hander Jakob Junis has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Angels Acquire SS Angel Arredondo in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels made a move on July 29, 2026, acquiring shortstop Angel Arredondo from the Texas Rangers in exchange for catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-handed pitcher Chase Silseth.
